details.description: Presenting new Rin Refresh Powder - with the promise of whiter and brighter clothes with the fragrance of lemon & rose, so that you can dress to progress! As you stride forward on your journey through life, Rin gives you the confidence to shine, all day, every day. With its superior technology, this detergent powder brightens your whites and coloured clothes and breathes life back into them so that your clothes shine like new. It dissolves quickly in water, targets and gets rid of the toughest of dirt. It also has a fragrance which ensures your clothes smell fresh and make you feel refreshed all day. With Rin by your side, let your confidence shine as bright as your clothes do! For bucket wash or machine wash, Rin works equally well to give you the brightest results. For bucket wash, simply use 1 scoop of detergent, soak clothes, rinse and dry. For machine wash, use 2 scoops of detergent for both top load and front load along with your regular wash settings and dry. Available in different packs, Rin is here to help you achieve the all-around cleanliness your clothes need.
details.usageInstructions:
1. Add up to 1 scoop (35 gms) of Rin powder in a bucket (10 lts) of water.
2. Mix the solution for about 15 - 30 seconds.
3. Separate your white garments from your coloured ones.
4. Soak your white garments and coloured garments in separate wash liquors for about 30 mins.
5. Gently rub the cuffs and collar/ stained portion of the garments.
6. Rinse the garments in water 2 - 3 times.
7. Squeeze excess water and dry.

details.description:
Presenting the new Rin Bar - with the promise of whiter and brighter clothes so that you can dress to progress! As you stride forward on your journey through life, Rin Bar gives you the confidence to shine, all day, every day. Rin Bar removes the dirt from the toughest places like cuff and colour with just one stroke. It also leaves your clothes with a pleasant fragrance to keep you feeling fresh all day long. With Rin Bar by your side, let your confidence shine as bright as your clothes do! Rin Detergent Bar is extremely easy to use. 
Use a scrubber to remove tougher dirt Rin Bar is available in convenient pack sizes of Rs. 5, Rs. 10, 250 g and 1000 g (4 packs of 250 g each). Rin Bar is here to help you achieve the all-round cleanliness your clothes need to shine bright. So what are you waiting for? Try the new Rin Bar to make clothes shine like new. Shine with your dazzling brightness for a long-lasting impression.
details.usageInstructions:
Step 1: Wet the cloth to be washed.
Step 2: Wet the bar.
Step 3: Apply the bar directly on the stained / heavily soiled area.
Step 4: Knead the fabric thoroughly.
Step 5: Rinse the fabric in water. 
Step 6: Squeeze the water away and dry. For stubborn stains use Brush along with the bar.
Washing Instructions for Bright Clothes: 
Soak clothes in a bucket of water.
Use Rin Bar directly on dirt areas – one stroke is enough.

details.description:
What if we told you you could dress up in your brightest best every day without having to spend a fortune on buying new clothes? With Rin Ala, you can now achieve the perfect shine on all your whites and that crispness you have been wanting to experience on your favourite set of formal wear. We understand that maintaining cottons and terrycots can be quite a task, taking a lot of time, effort, and money on various whitening products that often do not work. So why worry when Rin is here?
Rin Ala’s highly advanced bleach releases oxygen when added to water, which removes the toughest stains and makes your white clothes spotless and bright. You will be surprised by the minimal amount of rinsing or scrubbing required. Add a cap of this fabric whitener to your clothes and watch the magic happen in just a few minutes.
Did we also tell you that wearing them post-wash would feel like a dream? With Rin Ala, you will feel your confident best and outshine yourself every day, quite literally.

Experience the power of both bar and powder with Rin Liquid Detergent, designed to give you whiter and brighter clothes so you can dress to impress. As you move through your day, Rin provides the confidence to shine, every day. Its unique formula combines the cleaning strength of bar and powder, dissolving quickly in water to tackle even the most stubborn dirt. Enriched with a fresh fragrance, it keeps your clothes smelling pleasant throughout the day. Rin Liquid Detergent offers the convenience of replacing both bar and powder at a pocket-friendly price.
Suitable for both machine and bucket washes, Rin Liquid Detergent delivers consistently bright results. Use one cap for a regular load and two caps for heavily soiled laundry. For the toughest stains that refuse to budge, simply apply Rin Liquid Detergent directly onto the affected area for effective cleaning.
details.usageInstructions:
Apply a little liquid directly on tough dirt areas
For a bucket wash or a regular machine load, use 1 cap
Pour 1 cap of liquid into your machine or bucket. Wash as
usual
For large or very dirty loads, use 2 caps

details.description: Rin Matic Liquid is an innovative liquid laundry detergent designed to deliver powerful cleaning performance for top load washing machines and bucket washes, ensuring fabrics remain bright like new. Its advanced matic liquid formula dissolves completely, leaving no residue on clothes or in the machine, providing a hassle-free washing experience. Perfect for both white and coloured fabrics, this detergent combines the power of traditional powders and bars with the convenience of washing machine liquid detergent solution. Infused with a long-lasting fragrance, it keeps clothes smelling fresh and clean. Rin Matic Liquid is crafted to prevent fabric dullness and preserve the vibrancy of garments, making it an ideal choice for maintaining the colour of your clothes. Optimised for top load washing machine and bucket wash, it enhances the efficiency by preventing residue build-up, ensuring superior cleaning results. This versatile detergent caters to various fabrics and clothing types, offering a comprehensive solution for all laundry needs. Backed by Rin's heritage of excellence in fabric care, this liquid detergent reflects the brand's commitment to quality and innovation. The product provides up to 100 washes, delivering consistent brightness and freshness with every use. Perfect for households that value both performance and convenience, Rin Matic Liquid stands out with its ability to deliver dazzling brightness, long lasting fragrance, and hassle-free washing in every load.

Rin Liquids – Machine Specialist Range is a revolutionary liquid detergent formulated to deliver effective cleaning, dazzling brightness, and long-lasting fragrance.
Rin Liquid gives bright-like-new clothes when used in front load washing machines. For a normal load, add 1 cap of Rin Liquid. For a full load, add 1.5 caps to achieve ultimate cleanliness, enhanced brightness, and a long-lasting fresh fragrance.
The innovative formula dissolves completely in the machine without leaving any residue on clothes or inside the machine. It is designed to provide outstanding brightness for both white and coloured clothes, helping prevent dullness so clothes stay bright like new.
Suitable for all types of fabrics, whether white or coloured, this liquid detergent offers a mess-free wash, with no need for additional bars or powders.
Rin Matic Liquid combines superior cleaning with a long-lasting fragrance to ensure a delightful laundry experience. It features a balanced blend of freshness and modern, trendy fragrance notes that convey a sense of care with every wash.
Storage and Care
Store the bottle in a cool place. Wash hands immediately after use.
details.usageInstructions:
Pour 1 cap of liquid into your machine or bucket
Wash as usual
Use 60 ml for bucket wash or regular machine load
Use 90 ml for large or very dirty loads
